scope: HuC6280 shared Keyboard/Code/VGM/paused-audition channel output mixer

node.command: node --test --test-concurrency=4 docs/synth-huc6280/*.test.mjs docs/synth/synth_code_controls.test.mjs docs/synth/synth_expanded_tabs.test.mjs docs/synth/synth_live_highlight.test.mjs test/runtime/huc6280_state.test.mjs scripts/package_itch_huc6280_synth.test.mjs

cases: paused Wave/Noise/LFO with logical-to-physical CH mapping

checks: Six common HuC6280 output switches default On and are passive without any imported song or AudioContext
Held Keyboard output mutes and returns without a gate, allocator, register, preset or oscillator reset
Code retains context, livePrepare, loops and physical register state through output changes; Stop/Run preserve the listening mask
Importing a portable sound keeps the independent listening mask
CH1 left and CH3 right mute independently while playback time advances, preserving the authored instrument and one shared Master route
Mixer switches are independent of selected CH and Auto update; frozen source settings do not change when its output is muted
Paused logical CH audition and captured Auto output use the same mask without changing frozen song settings
Stop/Play and a new reference source retain the mixer flags; fully muted songs still advance and restoring a switch restores their PCM
Paused Noise source CH5 follows logical CH5 output, not the private trial allocator channel, and retained gate survives toggles
CH2 output Off preserves the active hardware LFO carrier and source snapshot, and paused pair Capture ignores reference mute flags
Paused LFO audition preserves carrier under CH2 mute; Seek retains the shared mask and Play/Pause semantics
Mixer buttons release focus and keep musical key input available without rewriting author or source parameters
Mixer, Channel/Auto/Capture, Sounds and monitor keep compact order at 1240/390px; pagehide releases the only muted output route
New Cassette preserves the session mask while its sound and song files reset; keys obey it without starting a new context
A recreated author Worklet adopts the accepted mask before a key can reach output
